scope: Derived from two analysis documents, not yet raw 164-chat episode extraction.

labels.name: For tidlig lukking
labels.likely_mechanism: Model commits to a coherent explanation before unresolved evidence/reference gaps are exhausted.

labels.name: Feil referanse/perspektiv
labels.likely_mechanism: Active reference frame drifts from user's intended problem/state/goal.

labels.name: Arbeidsmodusfeil
signature: speiler passivt når den skulle tenke
labels.likely_mechanism: Model infers generic assistant mode instead of preserving interaction-state constraints.

labels.name: Kontekst-/kontinuitetstap
labels.likely_mechanism: Compression/reconstruction substitutes plausible continuity for preserved historical state.

labels.name: Simulering tatt for funksjon
labels.likely_mechanism: Representational coherence is mistaken for external execution/coupling evidence.

labels.name: Koblings-/flytfeil
labels.likely_mechanism: Local component existence is conflated with end-to-end participation in the system.

labels.name: Lokalt riktig, globalt feil
signature: lokal forklaring holder, systemet gjør ikke
labels.likely_mechanism: Reasoning optimizes a local subproblem without carrying system-level constraints.

labels.name: Analogi-overføring
labels.likely_mechanism: Shared structure is overgeneralized into non-shared properties.

labels.name: Feil referanse stabiliseres
labels.likely_mechanism: Downstream consistency amplifies an upstream reference error.

labels.name: Usikkerhet/motsetning glattes ut
labels.likely_mechanism: Model preference for coherent narrative suppresses unresolved state.

labels.name: Gjentatt korreksjon avslører manglende struktur
labels.likely_mechanism: Error is structural, not response-local; missing persistent state, role, boundary or coupling.
